<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 137.56 ppm (2 carbons), 131.90 ppm (2 carbons), 130.00 ppm (4 carbons), and 128.40 ppm (4 carbons). All these chemical shifts fall in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). Summing the carbons represented by these peaks gives 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 = 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
